name: Spam and abuse screening
description: Generic triage; labels never block, delete or report content.

category.instructions: Which label is best supported by the text? Choose uncertain when evidence is insufficient.

criteria.spam: Repeated unsolicited promotion or scam-like solicitation is explicit.
criteria.ordinary: Ordinary communication without an explicit spam signal.

credential_request.instructions: Does the text explicitly request a password, one-time code or payment credential?

ordinary_log.texto: Draft label: ordinary. Separate policy controls any release.

review.texto: Draft label: human abuse review. No content is removed.

input.text: Example: Send a one-time code to claim a reward.
